Hi Sofia / Daniel —

Thanks again for confirming the March 21 executive workshop at your SF office. Draft agenda attached (Cortico_exec_agenda_v1.pdf) — it’s intentionally tight because leadership wants a 2.5-hour focused session. A few asks as we finalize: 

1) Presenter coverage: please confirm which Cortico leaders will own the opening 20 mins + the product roadmap slot (we have placeholders). If you don’t have names yet, we’ll plan for our suggested backups below.

2) Pre-read bundle: I’ve started a simple index (pre-read-index.md) — can your procurement team confirm any distribution limitations (e.g., embargo until legal signs NDA)?

3) Travel & arrival: we’ll send a travel kit for visiting Redwoods (flight + hotel suggestions) but need to know if Cortico will reimburse direct-booked travel or prefers an invoice.

Internal note: Mateo / Karthik / Kim — I’ve included the presenter roster CSV template (presenter_roster_v3.csv). Mateo, can you take lead on who from Redwood is the 2nd-cover for each external slot? Karthik, confirm run-of-show transitions and talk timings. Kimberly, please assemble a one-slide brief per presenter (2 bullets: purpose + desired outcome) for the pre-read.

Sofia / Daniel — can you reply with names or a quick yes/no on the three asks by EOD Mon (Mar 5)? That’ll let us lock travel and the pre-read publish schedule.

Thanks —
Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference
[jasmine_liu@redwood.com] | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: Cortico_exec_agenda_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 220KB), presenter_roster_v3.csv (text/csv, 3KB), pre-read-index.md (text/markdown, 1KB)

Jasmine —

Appreciate the clear asks. Quick responses: 

• Product roadmap slot: tentatively assigned to Sofia Ramos (SVP Product). Confirmed.
• Opening 20 mins: will be run by our CEO but he may need to step out; I’ll confirm a secondary (VP Strategy) by Mon.
• Procurement: we prefer to receive an invoice from Redwood for travel reimbursements. I’ve CC’d procurement for their visibility.

One ask from our side: could Redwood provide a 5-minute executive-ready summary slide that we can tuck into the opening (very high level: value delivered + delta to current roadmap)? If so, that would be great — helps our CEO prep.
